globals.name: APP_CONFIG
globals.reason: Server-rendered app configuration is intentionally exposed on window for bootstrapping and runtime config refresh.
globals.removal_target: Keep as the server bootstrap boundary for config data; remove only if templates pass config through a module bootstrap payload.

globals.name: PermData
globals.reason: Permalink/share pages receive server-rendered run data through a small window bridge before the controller starts.
globals.removal_target: Keep until permalink/share data is delivered through an explicit module bootstrap payload.

globals.name: ThemeRegistry
globals.reason: The theme registry is bootstrapped from server theme data and kept on the browser boundary so theme application can update the active runtime entry.
globals.removal_target: Keep as the theme bootstrap/runtime registry boundary while internal consumers use explicit theme module imports.

globals.name: AnsiUp
globals.reason: ansi_up is vendored as a classic browser global used by output and permalink rendering.
globals.removal_target: Keep while ansi_up remains a classic vendor script; remove if it moves behind an imported wrapper.

globals.name: jspdf

globals.removal_target: Keep while jsPDF remains a classic lazy vendor script; remove if it moves behind an imported wrapper.

globals.name: Terminal

globals.removal_target: Keep while xterm remains a classic lazy vendor script; remove if it moves behind an imported wrapper.

globals.name: FitAddon
globals.reason: The xterm fit addon is loaded as a classic vendor script and exposes FitAddon for interactive PTY.
globals.removal_target: Keep while the fit addon remains a classic lazy vendor script; remove if it moves behind an imported wrapper.

globals.name: showConfirm

globals.removal_target: Remove when those tests drive an in-app action or import the module API directly in the page context.
